# Kanzenshuu

> > The ultimate Dragon Ball encyclopedia and community resource covering the entire franchise including Dragon Ball, Dragon Ball Z, and Dragon Ball GT.

Kanzenshuu is the premier English-language Dragon Ball fan site, providing comprehensive coverage of home video releases, video games, merchandise, podcasts, and news about Akira Toriyama's Dragon Ball franchise. The site documents Japanese and international releases from publishers like Toei Animation, FUNimation, and Shueisha.

## Key Topics

- Dragon Ball Z
- Dragon Ball
- Dragon Ball GT
- Toei Animation
- FUNimation
- Z Dragon Box
- DVD releases
- Home video
- Budokai games
- R2 DVD
- Akira Toriyama
- Japanese releases
- Podcast episodes
- Video game coverage
- Voice actors

## Home Video & DVD Releases

- [Toei Dragon Ball R2 Individual DVD Covers 16-18](https://www.kanzenshuu.com/2007/08/24/toei-dragon-ball-r2-individual-dvd-covers-16-18): Toei Dragon Ball R2 DVD covers 16-18 featuring Piccolo-Daimao arc
- [Toei Dragon Ball Z R2 Individual DVD Covers 19-21](https://www.kanzenshuu.com/2006/04/06/toei-dragon-ball-z-r2-individual-dvd-covers-19-21): Toei Dragon Ball Z R2 DVD covers 19-21 from Z Dragon Box series
- [New Dragon Ball TV Dragon Box Images](https://www.kanzenshuu.com/2004/02/15/new-dragon-ball-tv-dragon-box-images): Dragon Box DVD set images with Tenka-ichi Budokai diorama revealed
- [Toei Dragon Ball Z R2 Individual DVD Covers 7-9](https://www.kanzenshuu.com/2005/12/17/toei-dbz-r2-individual-dvd-covers-7-9): Toei Dragon Ball Z R2 DVD covers 7-9 from Z Dragon Box collection
- [Dragon Ball GT Dragon Box DVD Set Delayed in Japan](https://www.kanzenshuu.com/2005/05/11/dragon-ball-gt-dragon-box-dvd-set-delayed-in-japan): Dragon Ball GT Dragon Box DVD release delayed in Japan by Shueisha
- [Toei Dragon Ball Z R2 Individual DVD Covers 13-15](https://www.kanzenshuu.com/2006/02/13/toei-dragon-ball-z-r2-individual-dvd-covers-13-15): Toei Dragon Ball Z R2 DVD covers 13-15 from Z Dragon Box series
- [Bardock & Trunks DVD Cover Art](https://www.kanzenshuu.com/2007/12/06/bardock-trunks-dvd-cover-art): FUNimation Bardock & Trunks TV specials double feature DVD cover art

## Video Games

- [Lots of "Budokai" Soundtrack Details](https://www.kanzenshuu.com/2004/12/28/lots-of-budokai-soundtrack-details): Budokai, Budokai 2, and Budokai 3 soundtrack release details and dates
- ["Sparking! NEO" First Videos](https://www.kanzenshuu.com/2006/05/01/sparking-neo-first-videos): First gameplay videos of Sparking! NEO PS2 game from IGN
- [Banpresto Lists New DBZ Game For Nintendo DS](https://www.kanzenshuu.com/2004/05/12/banpresto-lists-new-dbz-game-for-nintendo-ds): Banpresto announces new Dragon Ball Z game for Nintendo DS
- [New "Budokai 2" and WonderSwan Game Screen Shots](https://www.kanzenshuu.com/2003/08/19/new-budokai-2-and-wonderswan-game-screen-shots): Screenshots from Budokai 2 and Bandai WonderSwan games revealed
- ["Harukanaru Densetsu" American Box Art](https://www.kanzenshuu.com/2007/02/04/harukanaru-densetsu-american-box-art): North American box art for Harukanaru Densetsu Nintendo DS game
